name: QTT Product DocType
description: Static registry: which product a Frappe doctype belongs to. Product ownership is a property of the DOCTYPE, not of each row it contains — this is what lets the security engine resolve 'an LMS Course belongs to QMP_LMS' without a product field on every LMS row. Deliberately immutable after creation — see this doctype's permissions (no write/create/delete DocPerm granted to any role) and the hardening review section 3.

fields.label: DocType
fields.description: Must name a real, already-installed DocType — checked in validate(). A doctype belongs to exactly one product.

fields.label: Is Tenant Scoped
fields.description: 0 only for a product's rare platform-level/global doctypes that carry no per-tenant data at all.
